title: HELO checks that could not run read as not checked
items: When the mail host cannot look up the name a sending server introduced itself with (a DNS timeout or server failure), the deliverability report says the HELO name was not checked instead of saying it does not resolve, and counts nothing to fix
The sender setup on captured email carries an error on the HELO facts when that lookup failed, through the API, SDK and MCP server; mail captured earlier reads as before
The mail host caps the reverse DNS lookups it runs at once, so a burst of connections cannot start any number of them; a connection past the cap records its reverse DNS as not checked
